description: This Kotlin source file defines the 'ProductListActivity' class for an Android app. It manages the product listing screen with features including category filtering via chips, search, pagination, loading/error states, cart integration, preset filters, and UI state synchronization. The class interacts with ViewModels, adapters, and UI components to implement the main product browsing functionality in an online shopping platform.

classes.name: ProductListActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the product list screen with filtering, search, pagination, and cart interactions.

methods.name: ensureCartIdentityOrPrompt
methods.description: Checks if the cart has an active email; prompts user if not.

methods.name: setupCategoryChipsAndGrouping
methods.description: Initializes category chips UI and rebuilds sections based on categories.

methods.name: toggleGroupedMode
methods.description: Switches between grouped sections view and paged list view based on selected category.

methods.name: renderCategoryChips
methods.description: Sets up category selection chips with scrolling and snap behavior.

methods.name: rebuildGroupedSections
methods.description: Generates UI sections for each product category with lazy loading.

methods.name: maybeLoadSectionIfVisible
methods.description: Determines if a category section should load its preview when near viewport.

methods.name: loadSectionPreview
methods.description: Loads product preview for a specific category section.

methods.name: setupRecyclerAnimations
methods.description: Configures subtle item animations for the RecyclerView.

methods.name: setupPresetsAndClearAll
methods.description: Handles saving, applying, deleting presets, and clearing filters.

methods.name: setupSearchAndFilters
methods.description: Links search input and filter chips to ViewModel state.

methods.name: syncFilterControlsToState
methods.description: Updates UI controls to reflect current filter and search state.

methods.name: renderActiveFilterChips
methods.description: Displays chips representing active filters with removal options.

methods.name: showSavePresetDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to input name for saving a filter preset.

methods.name: showPresetsDialog
methods.description: Displays list of saved presets for applying or deleting.

methods.name: showPresetActionDialog
methods.description: Allows applying or deleting a specific preset.

methods.name: updateEmptyStateText
methods.description: Updates UI messaging based on search/filter results.
